limitations: File-IO points are coalesced by actual path/operation/phase; they are observations within the enclosing durable command, not fsync promises for business writes.
Source-read/mapping/discovery are streaming overlapping spans, not additive independent durations.
Pre-diagnostics bootstrap and diagnostic writer own IO use existing path preflight and writer health; excluded from recursive observation.
CrashReporter is not enabled; no managed Crashpad production dump creation.
No OS syscall interception and no live Jira/AI service execution.
